status: exploratory protocol frozen before interval outcomes; prior point results known; not external preregistration
purpose: Evaluate whether simple past-only residual calibration provides useful uncertainty for saved point forecasts; this does not recover native model quantiles
calibration: For each state/model/mode/lead and origin, use recorded signed residuals actual-prediction whose TARGET dates are in [origin-730 days, origin). Require at least 365 residuals. All residuals come from saved daily out-of-sample forecasts, not fitted training errors. Annual point-model refits remain different, so calibration distribution may shift. No outcome-dependent choice of window or method.
estimator: numpy.quantile on signed residuals, method=linear, add to current point forecast at every quantile. No nominal finite-sample/exchangeability coverage guarantee. Median may be bias-corrected; original point forecasts remain unchanged.
metrics: mean width divided by same past-training MASE scale
mean pinball across 0.05/0.5/0.95 divided by scale
event_membership: same fixed unshifted regional windows as original checkpoint
comparisons: identical recorded-label cases and calibration eligibility required across four configurations; never calibrate with target >= origin even for h=14
limits: calendar-event coverage has very few dates; report counts and years
no final untouched data and no native TSFM quantile forecasts
this tests a fixed calibration baseline, not every probabilistic method
